resolved_source_locations.conclusion: We study recombination-sensitive branch structure on a fixed-support substrate in Six Birds Theory. Building on prior work on event packaging and predictive holonomy, we introduce branch assemblages and two quotient levels at an interface: a branchwise predictive quotient ( K_i ), which captures independent predictive treatment of the branches, and a recombination quotient ( R_i ), which captures admissible recombination observables on branch families. On this architecture we exhibit a benchmark suite separating classical mixture, hidden predictive memory without recombination sensitivity, route-marked suppression, erasure-conditioned recovery, cyclic-family generalization, dissipative washout, and artifact controls based on protocol internalization and flattening/completion. A supporting theorem layer proves the abstract factorized no-interference regime and its obstruction by strict refinement, and one promoted positive family is connected to a theorem-backed concrete witness in an aligned Lean model. We do not claim a general reconstruction of non-Hilbert interference or a formalization of the full benchmark runtime. The claim is narrower: these recombination phenomena arise on fixed support, can be audited exactly, and admit a partial formal backbone on the Six Birds substrate.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: This appendix collects the formal definitions and theorem statements used in the main text. At the level of general mathematical form, the quotient and factorization language used here sits near behavioral equivalence, bisimulation, exact aggregation, and standard quotient-factorization arguments . It does not reproduce proofs. The comparison base is inherited from the first three papers of the series: fixed support and admissibility, the current and predictive quotients on single histories, and the branchwise and recombination quotients on branch assemblages. The present paper uses those inherited structures only to define and compare the flagship recombination family on a common exact-finite support. At the single-history level, the current quotient Q_i identifies reachable histories that are indistinguishable by the current event package, while the predictive quotient M_i identifies histories that remain indistinguishable under all admissible future generator/observable words on the reachable image. At the branch-assemblage level, the branchwise quotient K_i identifies assemblages with the same weighted multiset of predictive classes, while the recombination quotient R_i identifies assemblages that are indistinguishable by admissible later recombination observables. When recombination equivalence refines branchwise equivalence there is a canonical forgetful map _i : R_i → K_i .

General frameworks for mathematical models of consciousness ask what a model must declare before it says anything ; formal work on testability shows that inference procedures and prediction data can interact so badly that a theory becomes unfalsifiable or trivially falsified ; and large adversarial collaborations have demonstrated how much machinery is needed to test even two well-resourced theories against each other, without producing a definitive verdict . Landscape reviews count theory families by the dozen . In such a field, a paper's first obligation is to say exactly what kind of claim each of its sentences makes. Around that architecture it assembles a catalog of exact finite results, a small set of machine-checked kernels, and one explicitly priced ontological bridge. resolved_source_locations.conclusion: We propose that to be real is to have closed: that reality is not a substance, a substrate, or a set, but a ledger of survived closures. A thing is real when it is a package that earned its objecthood through audited gates and pays, continuously, to keep it. The proposal is grounded in the Six Birds corpus, which has spent the last years doing something Nietzsche predicted and no one else has attempted: worshipping the stone. The corpus constructs geometry, logic, time, probability, objects, events, agents, institutions, and selves from bare substrates, under explicit audit, with every failure banked and every success priced. The method of this paper is an itemized metaphysics. Every claim is either free, a theorem of the corpus at its stated grade, or purchased, spending one of two named axioms: Ontic Closure Completeness and Substrate Indifference. On this basis we argue that the Born rule's shape is the generic fate of compressed record layers, so that probability is born at the lens; that a simulation which passes a closure's gates is not a simulation of the thing but an instance of it, which is why lattice QCD computes the true proton; that ``matter'' and ``information'' are altitude labels, so that an economy is literally a ghost made of people; that mathematics is closure engineering in vitro, the design of lawful theory extensions ahead of any run, and in practice a map that unfolds only where someone walks; that the explanatory gap of consciousness is a non-descent certificate, predicted rather than embarrassing; that life and intelligence are graded, auditable positions on real axes rather than binaries; that a civilization which learns this grammar crosses into the era of meta-emergence, where creation itself is a wielded power, and that peace is a closure state, an achievement that strengthens rather than dissolves the identities it comprises; and that the great paradoxes (sorites, Theseus, Zeno, Mary's room, the unreasonable effectiveness of mathematics, the arrow of time) dissolve under ledger discipline, most of them because they demanded of a layer a certificate that no layer can issue. We close eight old problems and open eight new ones. The last sacrifice is Sacrifice itself.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: The most direct next construction is a within-agent learning or acquisition carrier, in which the individual agent is treated as a carrier object in the sense of the Six Birds treatment of agency . The failed crystallization bridge in shows that experience-as-composition selection makes the finite carrier more homogeneous and more stage-predictable, whereas the data show history-dependence growing with experience. A carrier in which individual agents acquire conditional rules over their own histories would test the mechanism that this contrast leaves open. A second direction is a broader family of noisy and dissipative carriers, to map route memory beyond the tested noise grid and to learn when currentizable traces become genuinely coherent. A third is to enlarge the strategic and payoff substrate: richer automata, larger action spaces, asymmetric games, and longer public signals would test which carrier facts persist and which are artifacts of the minimal catalog. The run layer also invites a bounded-rationality connection. The imitation dynamics used here contain a logit-style temperature parameter; in a maximum-entropy or shadow-price reading, such a parameter can be interpreted as the dual of a binding cognitive or informational budget rather than a free behavioral knob . That connection is only an opening in this paper, but it suggests how run-only constants might be tied to explicit resource constraints. On the empirical side, the immediate extension is broader pre-registered testing of the residue hypothesis and the timing reversal on other repeated-game datasets, with the same discipline: hypotheses, predictors, bands, folds, and amendments fixed before outcome analysis.
